code:
EPOCH = 1704067200000
WORKER_BITS = 10
SEQ_BITS = 12
MAX_SEQ = (1 << SEQ_BITS) - 1
MAX_WORKER = (1 << WORKER_BITS) - 1
SPAN_YEARS = int((1 << 41) / 1000 / 86400 / 365)


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def step(self):
        self.t += 1


class Snowflake:
    def __init__(self, worker, clock):
        self.worker = worker
        self.clock = clock
        self.last = -1
        self.seq = 0
        self.spins = 0
        self.rollbacks = 0

    def next_id(self):
        ts = self.clock.now()
        if ts < self.last:
            self.rollbacks += 1
            raise RuntimeError("clock moved backwards")
        if ts == self.last:
            self.seq = (self.seq + 1) & MAX_SEQ
            if self.seq == 0:
                while self.clock.now() <= self.last:
                    self.clock.step()
                    self.spins += 1
                ts = self.clock.now()
        else:
            self.seq = 0
        self.last = ts
        return ((ts - EPOCH) << (WORKER_BITS + SEQ_BITS)) | (self.worker << SEQ_BITS) | self.seq


def decode(i):
    ts = (i >> (WORKER_BITS + SEQ_BITS)) + EPOCH
    worker = (i >> SEQ_BITS) & MAX_WORKER
    seq = i & MAX_SEQ
    return ts, worker, seq


print("=== 雪花算法：位分配、单调性与时间回拨（确定性逻辑时钟）===")
print("位分配 = 1 符号位 + 41 时间戳位 + %d 机器位 + %d 序列位 = 64 位"
      % (WORKER_BITS, SEQ_BITS))
print("单机每毫秒上限 = 2^%d = %d, 单集群机器数上限 = 2^%d = %d"
      % (SEQ_BITS, MAX_SEQ + 1, WORKER_BITS, MAX_WORKER + 1))
print("起始纪元 EPOCH = %d, 41 位毫秒可支撑 %d 年" % (EPOCH, SPAN_YEARS))
print()

c1 = Clock(1704067200123)
sf1 = Snowflake(7, c1)
ids = [sf1.next_id() for _ in range(5)]
print("[同一毫秒内 5 次生成] worker=7")
for i, v in enumerate(ids):
    ts, wk, sq = decode(v)
    print("  id[%d] = %-22d decode -> ts=%d worker=%d seq=%d" % (i, v, ts, wk, sq))
print("  严格单调递增 : %s" % all(ids[i] < ids[i + 1] for i in range(len(ids) - 1)))
print()

print("[时间回拨] 时钟后退 1ms")
c1.t -= 1
try:
    sf1.next_id()
    print("  未检测到回拨（错误）")
except RuntimeError:
    print("  检测到回拨并拒绝发号 : True, rollbacks=%d" % sf1.rollbacks)
c1.t += 1
nxt = sf1.next_id()
print("  时钟恢复后继续发号，仍大于回拨前最后一个 ID : %s" % (nxt > ids[-1]))
print()

print("[序列耗尽] 固定毫秒起连续生成 5000 个 ID（上限 %d/ms）" % (MAX_SEQ + 1))
c2 = Clock(1704067200000)
sf2 = Snowflake(7, c2)
big = [sf2.next_id() for _ in range(5000)]
print("  唯一 ID 数 = %d / %d" % (len(set(big)), len(big)))
print("  严格单调递增 : %s" % all(big[i] < big[i + 1] for i in range(len(big) - 1)))
print("  序列耗尽后自旋等待下一毫秒 : spins = %d" % sf2.spins)
for idx in (0, 4095, 4096):
    ts, wk, sq = decode(big[idx])
    print("  id[%d] ms = %d, seq = %d" % (idx, ts, sq))
print()
print("结论1：ID 高位是时间戳，整体趋势递增，对 B+ 树聚簇索引是顺序写入。")
print("结论2：机器位（%d 位 -> %d 台）保证多节点不撞号，序列位（%d 位 -> %d/ms）保证单节点同毫秒不撞号。"
      % (WORKER_BITS, MAX_WORKER + 1, SEQ_BITS, MAX_SEQ + 1))
print("结论3：回拨必须显式处理（拒绝发号 / 等待追平），否则会生成重复 ID。")
